repairs.quote: K'Sante shatters his ntofos to Knock Back an enemy champion, dealing 80/115/150 physical damage, then dashes behind them and goes All Out for 15s. If the enemy would hit a wall, they are Knocked Back through the wall and K'Sante strikes them again for (80/115/150 + (5% bonus Health)) physical damage. While All Out, K'Sante's Abilities are upgraded and he gains 40/60/80% Attack Speed, 50% Bonus Armor Penetration, and 20% Omnivamp, but loses 35% max Health, 85% Bonus Armor, and 85% Bonus Magic Resistance. K'Sante is Unstoppable and Roots his target while casting this Ability.
